status: index-only; not a policy bundle, competence attestation, matchup result, or field evaluation
purpose: Compact, source-pinned index of existing Aichi opponent-policy challenge cases for conversion into regression and held-out challenges for one shared seat-symmetric policy/search implementation.

benchmark.primaryEstimand: One English-language paper Expanded candidate against the unchanged original Aichi Japanese Extra Top 32 lists; custom cross-format challenge, not a sanctioned Expanded-vs-Expanded result.

referenceCandidate.name: Hood Shield Shadow Rider v1
referenceCandidate.status: leading developmental challenger; not selected as final fixed 60

sharedPolicyContract.implementation: One reusable policy/search implementation must pilot either physical seat and any exact source deck; rank/deck identity comes only from a frozen source manifest, never a rank-specific runtime policy module.
sharedPolicyContract.observationBoundary: Actor-visible observation, legal action frontier, and permitted public history/receipts only; never opponent hidden zones or physical RNG/seed as policy inputs.
sharedPolicyContract.evaluation: Same architecture on both seats; preserve development/held-out split; held-out cases never tune policy; source-natural/native-staged/synthetic evidence remain distinct.

coverage.note: Only source suites found in the current public tree are indexed. Absence here is not proof that no private or uncommitted suite exists; it is not permission to invent a proxy.

structuralCompletenessContract.note: Structural completeness only; it does not prove actor-only privacy, strategic correctness, native execution, or competence.
